summary.headline: Planetary Motion and Fixed Stars
summary.text: Discussion of planetary motion, comparing Mercury, Venus, and Mars in fast, slow, direct, and retrograde states, and distinguishing true motion from mean motion. The text gives the fixed stars’ cycle as 24,000 years—about 2,000 years per sign and 66 years per degree—and cites Tusi’s Thirty Chapters, Aristotle, and later observers.
